name: K-Swiss Court Express Pickleball Shoe
description: A lightweight court shoe tuned for the fast lateral cuts pickleball demands at the kitchen line. A wide, low-to-the-ground platform improves stability on quick direction changes, while a breathable mesh upper keeps the foot cool through long tournament days.
care_instructions: Wipe the upper with a damp cloth after outdoor play and let shoes air dry away from direct heat. Do not machine wash or dry; this can delaminate the midsole.
